lines: Perumal Ramamurthy Srinivasan is an Investor Selling Shareholder, offering up to 6,750 shares for up to ₹0.91 crore, if all are sold.
Proceeds of up to ₹0.91 crore were calculated from the offer price; the employee-portion shares sell at a discount, so actual proceeds are slightly lower.
The money has been in hand since 11 Mar 2026 (8 months ago); the trigger is recent, with shares unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, 66 days ago.
Confidence is medium: the name is verified in the seller table, but holdings appear in one section only (promoter_holding).
